thesis: The speakers argue that stablecoins are finally gaining traction because blockchain infrastructure has matured to allow transactions under a penny in under a second, combined with new regulatory clarity. They posit that this efficiency, alongside the ability for AI agents to transact directly from crypto wallets, will disrupt the traditional financial system by replacing inefficient intermediaries and high-cost cross-border transfers.
